analysis: Examined docs/reference/configuration.md:1–480 against the canonical asset/threat index and supplied T-041 detail. Within these units, the substantive addition is line 371: persistent verified-weight records and startup reuse based on file device, inode, size, mtime and ctime. This introduces a documented trust contract relevant to A-004, T-012, T-027 and TB-003: an operator-owned record must not become independent proof of weight integrity against an adversarial provider. The documentation alone establishes neither forgeable record acceptance nor a routing bypass, so no concrete regression is supported here. Integration must examine ProviderCore/Service/VerifiedWeightHashStore.swift together with managed-load verification, startup registration and cache model/weight bindings: record provenance, complete artifact coverage, mutation/race handling, and whether reused hashes are advisory or authorize serving/cache adoption. Owner-only permissions do not by themselves protect records from ADV-001. T-041's verified-weight and scope bindings remain relevant, but no change to cache encryption, authenticated account scoping, TTL or purge behavior is evidenced in these units. Surrounding authorization, endpoint-resumption, logout, drain and inference configuration text is unchanged according to the complete range map; it does not establish implementation correctness. Changes at head lines 568 and 584–590 lie outside the supplied excerpts and require coverage in another pass. No supported documentation-only security finding was identified; the weight-record acceptance contract remains materially unverified.
